values: Use Tracker as the working sheet. Dashboard formulas summarize the current audit state automatically.
Keep Tracker as the single source of truth and do not create competing trackers.
Create one row per user-visible feature or critical behavior. User stories describe how a user uses the feature, not how the implementation works.
Use Status during discovery and testing, then use Final Status after retest.
Record commit hashes in column S for any row touched by a fix or follow-up pass.
Use Lists sheet values for Status, Severity, Test Type, and Final Status to keep reporting clean.
Append a dated note to CHANGELOG.md after each completed QA or improvement pass.
Keep the CSV, XLSX, and HTML companion aligned after every tracker update.
Open the Dashboard tab for a quick pass/fail snapshot before closing the loop.
